questions.stem: In the number $0.0482$, what is the value of the digit $4$?
questions.explanation: The digits after the decimal point occupy tenths, hundredths, thousandths, etc. In $0.0482$, the $4$ is in the hundredths column, giving a value of $0.04$.

questions.stem: The number $2.6$ million written in figures is:
Which digit has the greatest value in $86,\!305$?
questions.explanation: The digit $8$ is in the ten-thousands place, giving it a value of $80,\!000$. This is greater than $6,\!000$ (the $6$), $300$ (the $3$), or $5$ (the $5$).
